title: Servius (and 'Servius Danielis'), Commentarii in Vergilii Aeneidos libros, Books 2–12 / RU: Сервий, «Комментарии к Энеиде»
author: Maurus Servius Honoratus (fl. c. 400), plus a later expanded layer (Servius Danielis)
date: c. 400–420 CE; the expanded layer compiled 7th–8th c.
size: Aeneid commentary est. 300k+ words; Aen. 6 alone est. 25–30k words
ru_evidence: Book 1 only: N. A. Fedorov, in Вергилий. Энеида. С комментариями Сервия (Лабиринт 2001); see ancientrome.ru/antlitr/servius and ru.wikipedia.
en_evidence: Isolated books only, e.g. Aen. 4 (McDonough, Prior & Stansbury 2004; cited from memory, not re-checked). en.wikipedia lists no complete translation.
value: The most influential ancient commentary on Latin poetry: grammar, religion, antiquarian lore and fragments of lost authors. The very model of 'scholia' for a platform called Neoscholia.
ai_feasibility: high: plain didactic Latin. Difficulties: lemma layout and separating the Servian and expanded layers.
pilot_unit: Commentary on Aeneid 6 (underworld, religion and philosophy; est. 25–30k words), or Aen. 2 (est. 15–20k words)
